items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Hot Lips Page had a band, a small group, they played in between with Tommy

ctx.x: You know I think Conte told me a story about you were playing in Chicago or something and you forgot your mouthpiece. And he had to come up and deliver it to you or something.

Yeah. I think I remember that. I says I didn’t have my mouthpiece. And you can’t play like you play without — it’s like wearing someone else’s gloves or shoes, something’s wrong with them. Especially when, obviously like I have no calluses on my hand so I can’t play the guitar. It’s about that simple. I didn’t even worry about anything, to be honest with you, but I remember when I was with Tommy Dorsey at the Sherman Hotel, Hot Lips Page had a band, a small group, they played in between with Tommy and then we’d…
Yeah, yeah, you’ve got to say something.
